column1: The reference capture's mutually exclusive sub-quest completions are emitted at chapter level as `mutuallyExclusiveQuestPairs`. Partial objective progress on both sides is allowed. Only pairs of resolved sub-quests within this chapter are included. Objective coverage is partial (see `referenceCoverage`): the client only returns a story sub-quest template once the player has reached it, so only the endings whose `objectiveCount` is above zero have objective-level evidence here. The armored case choice in Falling Skies affects available optional objectives (Lightkeeper access).
